ftbquests.chapter.deep_dark_secrets.ques: Buried deep beneath the world hides a dangerous secret, the echoes of our ancestor's mistakes. A hostile force waits patiently for its time. Quietly it consumes souls, writhing and growing in the hopes of gaining a foothold in our world.
Visit the Deep Dark
Visit the Deep Dark
A Dangerous Secret

Long ago our ancestors tried to harness a deadly power from another world, but were consumed by it instead. Now the cities rest deep underground beneath mountains as somber monuments to arrogance and folly. These ancient places are full of chests filled with treasures and breakable ancient vases brimming with resources to reward the brave, but beware as you walk through the Cities of Lost Souls, for its keeper awaits.
&lWarning: When breaking Ancient Vases without silk touch there is a low chance that sculk leeches or a stalker might spawn. Break at your own risk. &r
Visit an Ancient City
Visit an Ancient City
City of Lost Souls

Can you truly defeat such a terrifying construct of sculk, souls, and bone? The rhythmic beating of the Warden's heart echoes in your head, it beckons to you to go somewhere even deeper and darker. Will you take its heart and answer its call?
Kill a Warden. It is highly recommended that you be equipped with Netherite gear.
Kill a Warden and Take It's Heart
And Yet It Still Beats

The darkness brought by this corruption is a frightening obstacle that can leave you lost and scrambling. If you're to delve into the depths of another world it might be best to repurpose your foe's power to your advantage. To do so you will need to use the materials you’ve obtained from the warden and phantoms, an upgrade tablet and echo shard found within the Ancient Cities, and a netherite gear to upgrade in a smithing table.
Craft a reinforced Echo Shard, Craft a Warden Helmet
True Sight
A heart beats with malice and two worlds connect once more. What awaits you on the other side? There's only one way to find out. Are you ready to confront the unknown?
&lPlease note that you must clear the inside of the Ancient City portal of any skulk veins before using the Warden's heart to activate it.&r
Enter the portal
Visit the Otherside
The Darkness Awaits

The Otherside seethes with both danger and beauty. Lost in a strange new world you are surrounded by new biomes and enemies that provide new resources and treasures. Take care and tread carefully to discover what this realm hides.

The Otherside at its core is a resource rich cave realm filled with new enemies and blocks to enhance your deep dark experience. Watch your step as you traverse it; sculk jaws and infested sculk hide amongst the landscape ready to bite you and steal exp or unleash a shriek worm respectively.
Visit the 4 unique biomes of the Otherside
Explore all Otherside biomes
The Otherside

These extremely rare structures are found in the Deeplands and hold the ultimate secrets of the Otherside; Wireless storage and the self-boosting Soul Elytra. But be careful, the powerful Stalker hides within and keeps you from your prize. You’ll need the soul crystals the stalker holds, but defeating such a foe will be difficult. Only approach these temples of silence if you are well prepared.
The Soul Elytra features a recharging bar that allows you to boost without rockets. The hotkey is &lB&r by default. It also has more durability than a regular Elytra and provides you with 3 armor.

The Sculk Transmitter is a wireless access device that can be linked to many different storage or crafting interfaces by shift-right clicking on the block you wish to link to. Once linked just right click with the transmitter in hand. Transmitters can be linked to shulker boxes, anvils, crafting tables, stonecutters, cartography tables, smithing tables, grindstones, looms, furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, enchanting tables, brewing stands, beacons, chests, barrels, dispensers, droppers, hoppers and trapped chests.
Find an Ancient Temple
Find an Ancient Temple
The Final Abyssal Secret
You know all too well that sculk is powered by the souls of the dead, so perhaps the strange dust and bones some of the creatures drop could be useful?

Soul dust and sculk bones are  key components to make one of the most powerful items in deeper and darker, the Soul Elytra! The dust can also be used to create sound proof glass or combined with an invisibility potion in a brewing stand to create a Sculk Affinity potion. This potion prevents you from making vibrations that trigger sculk sensors or cause shriek worms to spawn, an extremely useful effect if you plan on spending a lot of time in the Otherside.
&lKill sculk leeches or a sculk snapper and obtain Soul dust. Kill shattered to obtain sculk bones.&r
Obtain Soul Dust. Obtain a Sculk Bone.
All is Dust

ftbquests.chapter.forged_fables.quest.0A: Necoium Carrots give Necoium Share which links nearby entities that ate Necoium Carrot. The strongest active Mythic effect on any member is shared to all connected members within 30 blocks.
ftbquests.chapter.forged_fables.title: Forged Fables
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.5B: Welcome to Hexalia, a mod focused around nature based magic! In this unique mod you'll grow magical crops and herbs, perform rituals and infusions, brew useful new potions, and even learn to care for cute silk moths in your witchy adventures.

To get you started on your journey you'll first want a Verdant Grimoire, your one stop guide to all the knowledge and possibilities ahead of you. This is achieved by crafting a book with some witchweed, an herb that can be found throughout the world. Be careful not to step on it!
Find Witchweed and craft it with a book.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.3D: There are many tools you will need as you progress, but the two most important ones to get you started are the Mortar and Pestle and the Athame. The herbs you'll be using often need to be crushed and a key ingredient, tree resin, must be harvested using an Athame.

To use a pestle place it down and right click with the item you wish to crush. The mortar can hold up to 3 items. Once you have your items loaded shift right click 3 times to crush your herbs. Right click again to retrieve the resulting item.

The Athame is extremely simple to use. You simply right click with it to gather tree resin as you would with an axe to strip logs. The only restriction is that only Dark Oak and Cottonwood trees will produce resin.
Craft a Mortar and Pestle with a stone and bowl. Craft an Athame with a stick and flint.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.63: You'll need to gather 5 herbs to begin diving deep into all Hexalia has to offer, but these magical herbs are rare and often hard to find. While you might pick up one or two of these herbs while exploring, an easier way to obtain them is through Mutavis. Mutavis will mutate regular mundane plants into their magical equivalent.

To craft Mutavis you will need to combine tree resin, a crushed herb (the previous quest provided you some spirit powder to use!), and a slime ball together in a mortar and pestle and crush them together.
Craft Mutavis using tree resin, a crushed herb, and a slime ball in a mortar and pestle.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.59: It's time to get down to gather your herbs! As previously mentioned the magical herbs you need are rare, but they can be found in the world. If you're struggling to find one consider mutating it instead. That said, you'll still need to find the mundane equivalent out in the world. You also might very rarely find an Herbalist Hut in a swamp or mangrove swamp stocked with the plants you need.
Spirit Blooms are native to swamps and mangrove swamps or can be mutated from Blue Orchids.
Dreamshrooms are found in Old Growth Pine Taiga and Mushroom Fields or mutated from Brown Mushrooms.
Siren Kelp is found in oceans or mutated from Kelp.
Ghost Ferns are found in Dark Forests or by mutating a Fern.
Celestial Blooms can be found in Meadows, Old growth Birch Forests, Birch Forests, Flower Forests, or mutated from any color of Tulip.
Salt Sprouts are mutated from Cactus.
Gather or mutate a plant into a spirit bloom, dreamshroom, siren kelp, ghost fern, celestial bloom and saltsprout.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.38: Now that you have your herbs you can craft some special dirt for your magical garden. While you can bonemeal herbs on regular soil, if you do it on infused dirt you will get 2 per bonemeal instead of 1. You can also hoe this dirt to create Infused Farmland which allows your crops to grow without any water blocks nearby, including plants with restrictions like saltsprouts or sugar cane.
Combine 2 Dirt and 2 Siren Kelp together in a crafting table.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.37: You're drawing close to tapping into the magic of the materials you've gathered so far. To that end you require one more tool to help you channel and activate that magic, the Hex Focus. Crafted from a Stick, any Leaf block, and an Amethyst Shard, the Hex Focus will allow you to activate rituals and as well as some magical flowers you can craft through those same rituals.
Combine a stick, leaf block and an Amethyst Shard diagonally in a crafting table.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.66: Craft a Celestial Crystal and Galeberries using Celestial Infusion.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.23: Conduct a Nature's Ritual to create a Rabbage.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.11: Rituals aren't where your witchy adventures end, you can also craft various powerful potions known as Brews. To do so you'll first need to craft a Small Cauldron, a ladle to stir your mixture, and rustic bottles to bottle your brews.

Once crafted and placed down, light your cauldron's built-in campfire with a flint and steel. Next, fill the cauldron with water and load it with up to 4 ingredients. Stir with your ladle until the ingredient sprites disappear and potion swirls emit from the cauldron. You'll have to wait 4 minutes while your brew cooks. The color of the water will change once the cooking is done and the brew can be bottled with a rustic bottle. Be careful not to let it overcook past the 4 minutes or the amount produced will drop to one bottle!
Craft a Small Cauldron, Rustic Bottle, and Ladle.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.0A: With your herb garden well established you should hopefully have a stockpile of herbs to spare by now. You have been using them for crafting or processing them into crushed variants, but they can also be used in their raw form by burning them to create an area of effect aura. Want to pacify undead creatures or potentially turn a cow into a Mooshroom? To do so burn two herbs together in a censer with a flint and steel. See your grimoire for the various combinations.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.51: Another important crafting material needed for many recipes is Silk Fibers. These come from farming Silk Moths, fragile magical insects drawn to light that can be found in forests and captured in rustic bottles. Alternatively, if you're having trouble finding them, you can plant some Ghost Ferns around a Cottonwood Sapling and it will occasionally spawn with a silk cocoon that can be hatched into a moth by right-clicking it with a light source such as a torch after a small delay.

Once you have yourself some moths you can begin to breed them with Fragrant Nectar produced in a mortar and pestle. When they're successfully bred they'll lay eggs on leaf or nesting blocks. Nests are recommended as when the eggs hatch they are stored in an internal storage where eggs hatched from leaves will simply drop to the ground. These eggs hatch into silk worms which can then either be placed on logs to form cocoons for new silk moths or combined with leaves to produce silk fibers. Silk fibers can also be obtained from silk moths on death.
Obtain Silk Fibers through the farming of Silk Moths.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.4A: Out in the jungle you might run into a Cacofey, a mischievous creature that enjoys stealing food from players and running away. A nuisance at first, these green sprites will help you to harvest crops if you tame them with a gale cookie. Once tamed they can be bound to a chest or container by right-clicking them with a hex focus and shift-right-clicking the container. Then you can set their behavior to wandering by right-clicking them with empty hands and they will harvest any nearby crops and place them in the container.
Use a Gale Cookie to tame a Cacofey.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.26: Crafted through nature's rituals, these nodes are the base for many useful crafting recipes.
Craft a Fire, Water, Air, and Earth Node through Nature's Ritual.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.7B: Ever wanted your tools to have multiple functions? Look no further than the Briar Sickle and Rootshaper.
The Briar Sickle is a tool that can clear vegetation in a 3x3 area or be used as shears for blocks by shift-right-click.

The Rootshaper is a highly enchantable tool that automatically switches between being a shovel or a pickaxe depending on what you're mining. You can also press shift while mining to toggle a mining mode that clears a 3x3x1 area.
Craft a Briar Sickle and a Rootshaper.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.06: Used to transport or store mobs easily, the spiritroot tether can be right-clicked on a mob to "store" it. The mob is released by simply right-clicking with it again. The tether can also be bound to a Spirit Bloom to allow you to teleport captured mobs home by holding shift while right-clicking to release the mob.
The Heartseed is a rare seed used to tame any tameable animal instantly. The seed is consumed upon use.
Craft a Spiritroot Tether and Heartseed.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.60: A pendant that when held in your offhand increases the amount of exp gained. It loses durability when exp is used.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.7F: Salves are emergency consumables that provide temporary effects for survival and combat. The Brambleguard Salve provides a defensive buff and immunity to bleeding and the Mender's Salve provides regeneration.
Craft a Brambleguard Salve and a Mender's Salve.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.3B: Some gear to provide you with some environmental protection and buffs. The Ghost Veil will reduce the detection radius of mobs. The Bogshade Boots provide increased swim speed and bonus speed when walking on mud, perfect for your witch's swamp. Finally the earplugs will protect you from the effects of Mandrake screams.
Craft a Ghost Veil, Bogshade Boots, and Earplugs.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.72: Silken armor providing resistance against magic damage such as wither or dragon's breath. The Moonweave armor also provides a 2 minute bonus duration to any brew consumed.
Craft a full set of Silkweave Armor and a full set of Moonweave Armor.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.4F: Be the ultimate nature lover with this flowery set of armor that provides reduced knockback, damage reflection, regeneration when around flowers, and bonus movement speed when walking on leaves.
Craft a full set of Bloomwrap Armor.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.0E: Very rarely in Jungle Temples you can find an Ancient Seed that can be turned into the mighty Kelpweave Blade, a blade that inflicts slowness on your enemies and has riptide-like abilities in the rain or water all without being enchanted.
The Cinderhew is a throwable axe that deals extra fire damage and returns to its owner's inventory.
Hate carrying arrows? Consider making a Thornbow, a bow that forms its own arrows that can inflict bleeding at the cost of durability.
Craft a Kelpweave Blade, Cinderhew, and Thornbow.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.3F: Useful consumables for when you get into a fight. Remove negative statuses from yourself with the purifying sac, or debuff your enemies by throwing one of any of the other options. Sneak-right-click to throw and apply effects in a small area.
Craft a Purifying, Foul, Frost, and Searing Sac.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.5D: Idols are artifacts made for manipulating the weather or removing curses from equipment. Right-click to use and summon a storm, or chase away the rain. Hold cursed equipment in one hand and the idol in the other and free your items of their curse.
Craft a Silk, Rainfall, Clarity, Tempest, and Purifying Idol.
So You Want to be an Idol
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.0A: A defensive charm against phantoms. When placed and fueled by a Fire Node the Dreamcatcher will burn any phantoms and apply slowness to them periodically within its radius.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.37: Obtained through Nature's Ritual, these flowers produce various effects when given certain items or activated with your Hex Focus. See your grimoire for the full list.
Craft a Morphora, Grimshade, Nautilite, Windsong, Astrylis, Lourdes, and Aegiflora.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.14: A way to store herbs, store up to 8 per jar. Saves its inventory when broken for easy carrying.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.18: The Seafoam Talisman restores breath underwater.
The Moonward Ring clears Blindness and Darkness.
The Witchheart Cluster grants two extra hearts.
The Wyrd Feather gives you a chance to avoid damage from melee or projectile strikes.
The Green Omen sometimes doubles the amount of crops harvested.
Find a Seafoam Talisman, Moonward Ring, Witchheart Cluster, Wyrd Feather, and Green Omen as loot in structure chests.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.49: Hexalia adds magical crops that let you cook foods with useful buffs.
Sunfire Tomatoes are found in vanilla savannas. Be careful, walking over them sets you on fire!
Mandrakes grow in Forests and Birch Forest biomes. They stun enemies on right-click or can be made into stew. Wear earplugs when farming or you'll stun yourself!
Chillberries are found in taigas and snowy taigas. Don't walk over them or you'll start to freeze.
Collect 1 Sunfire Tomato seed, 1 Mandrake seed and 1 Chillberry
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.41: A magical kick of speed from a super spicy sandwich. Eating this grants you Speed II for 45 seconds.
Combine Bread, Sunfire Tomatoes, and any cooked meat in a crafting table.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.66: This stuffing stew grants the Overfed buff, preventing Saturation loss for 45 seconds.
Combine Mandrake, Potato, Carrot and Bowl in a crafting table.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.6C: A cold tart pie that grants Fire Resistance II for 45 seconds.
Combine Sugar, Wheat, Egg and Chillberries.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.11: A magical ray of Night Vision from a super cold cookie. Eating this grants you Night Vision II for 45 seconds.
Combine Sugar, 2 Wheat, and a Galeberry in a crafting table.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.15: Combine tree resin, an enderpearl, spirit powder, and a galeberry in a small cauldron.
Grants the Homestead effect which teleports you back to your assigned spawn point such as your bed.
Brew up a Brew of Homestead
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.69: Combine a slimeball, chillberries, tree resin, and a feather in a small cauldron.
Grants the Slimewalker effect which negates fall damage and allows you to bounce upwards if you press the sneak key.
Brew up a Brew of Slimewalker
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.2A: Combine a celestial crystal, iron nugget, sweetberries, and tree resin in a small cauldron.
Grants the Spikeskin effect, which increases toughness and reflects a portion of damage received like the thorns enchant.
Brew up a Brew of Spikeskin
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.3B: Combine dream paste, siren paste, an iron ingot, and redstone dust in a small cauldron.
Grants the Siphon effect, increasing mining speed and makes items attract to you from a further distance.
Brew up a Brew of Siphon
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.55: Combine a sunfire tomato, spirit powder, glowberries, and witchweed in a small cauldron.
Grants the Daybloom effect that allows you to move faster and regenerate during the day, however darkness will harm you.
Brew up a Brew of Daybloom
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.37: Combine a mandrake, spirit powder, tree resin, and rotten flesh in a small cauldron.
Grants the Bloodlust effect that makes you stronger and heals you for a portion of the damage you deal.
Brew up a Brew of Bloodlust
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.6A: Combine a spider eye, ghost powder, black dye, and string in a small cauldron.
Grants the Arachnid Grace effect that allows you to freely move through cobwebs, climb up walls vertically, and makes you immune to poison.
Brew up a Brew of Arachnid Grace
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.65: Combine a feather, ghost paste, chillberries, and a block of sculk in a small cauldron.
Silences your presence around sound-sensitive entities such as the Warden at the cost of periodically applying the darkness effect.
Brew up a Brew of Hollow Silence
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.18: Combine spirit powder, rotten flesh, witchweed, and tree resin in a small cauldron.
While under its effects this brew causes any monsters slain to leave behind a small mossy patch with fresh herbs and plants growing from it.
Brew up a Brew of Gravebloom

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.1CDC74: CozyStudios Core is the framework mod built by the CozyCord team that powers Homestead. It's meant to feel vanilla-friendly, lightweight, and configurable, adding cozy content without turning your world into something unrecognizable.
&lCustom Mobs&r – Fernlings, Mushlings, and the Mystical Elk, all tameable and breedable, with multiple biome variants.

&lVillager Additions&r – A new Arborist profession plus an expanded Mason trade pool.
&lQuality of Life&r – Recolor beds and banners, hunger in Peaceful, bigger stacks, and craftable mob drops.

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.2BCDA4: Peaceful little spirits that help your farms flourish.

&l- Tame and breed with:&r Cozy Crumbs

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.5F2322: Tiny mushroom pals that light your way at night.

• Can be tamed and told to sit

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.21207E: Majestic mounts from the deep woods.

• Rideable like a horse once saddled
• Speed and jump stats are randomized per elk, so it's worth hunting for a good roll

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.5A7C35: Protective blocks that carve out a safe zone around themselves. They repel hostile mobs and stop them spawning, and they come in four tiers.
Radius can be raised by up to 100% in the config under the Tranquil Lanterns category.

Press &lR&r while standing inside a lantern's range to light up the protected area. The keybind lives under "Cozy Studios Core" in your controls.

8x Diamond Block around 1x Golden Tranquil Lantern
8x Netherite Ingot around 1x Diamond Tranquil Lantern

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.41210C: Keep one in your inventory for slow, endless health regen.
Right-click to eat it for a Golden Apple effect. Three uses before it's gone.
Needed for the base Tranquil Lantern.

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.779694: • Smelts building blocks like stone, bricks, terracotta, and clay &l2x faster&r

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.622E45: The job block for the new Arborist villager profession.
&lRecipe:&r 1 Barrel surrounded by any type of Sapling.
Place one near an unemployed villager and they'll take up the job.
ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.2AD4CB: A new goat horn variant, found in Jungle Temples.

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.00E6CF: Recolor beds, wool, and banners instead of remaking them.

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.5993EE: Crafting recipes for items you'd normally only get from hostile mobs, so Peaceful players aren't locked out.
Beef, Chicken, Porkchop, Mutton, Rabbit, Cod, Salmon, Tropical Fish

ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.096514: Useful building materials added to the Mason trade pool.

Items that normally cap at 16 stack up to 64. Configurable anywhere between 16 and 64.
A handful of practical additions like Grindstone to Gravel, plus Saddle, Name Tag, and Horse Armor recipes.
ftbquests.chapter.homestead.quest.258076: Nearly everything in CozyStudios Core can be tuned: mob behavior, block functions, villager trades, recipes, recolor rules, stack sizes, and lantern radius.

A Thing or Two About Things

Place 8x Hop Seeds

Kvass

Nether Star Lager

ftbquests.chapter.signals_in_the_stillne: &4&lWireless Redstone&r&r lets you transmit redstone signals &nwirelessly&r using a system of &lTransmitters&r, &lReceivers&r, and tools like &lRemotes&r and &lSniffers&r. All of these tools use a shared crafting component: the &lCircuit&r. You'll need a few of these along your journey.
Complete to begin exploring the Wireless Redstone mod.

The Redstone Transmitter sends redstone power wirelessly to a Redstone Receiver on the same frequency. You can power it using any normal redstone input (torch, block, lever, etc.). Right-click it to change the frequency. Multiple systems can run in parallel on different channels.
The Redstone Receiver receives power from any Redstone Transmitter on the same frequency. Right-click it to change its frequency. Match it to a Transmitter’s frequency to complete a wireless circuit.

The Frequency Sniffer helps you locate the Transmitter tied to a specific frequency. Shift-right-click to set the frequency. Then right-click to highlight the corresponding transmitter in bright red for 10 seconds—even through blocks and across any distance. It also posts the block's coordinates to chat.

The Remote manually powers a Redstone Transmitter. Shift-right-click to set a frequency. Then right-click to activate the transmitter at that frequency for as long as the click is held. Perfect for toggling devices from afar.

The Frequency Tool copies and pastes frequencies between transmitters and receivers. Shift-right-click to set a frequency. Right-click to apply it to a block. To copy a block's frequency, shift-right-click the block with the tool, then right-click another to paste.

ftbquests.chapter.tips.quest.4B7E829C1A5: The Mob Explosion Griefing mod splits vanilla's mobGriefing rule into separate toggles, so you can disable specific griefing without turning it all off.

&lcreeper_griefing&r: set to false and Creepers no longer destroy blocks when exploding.
&lghast_griefing&r: set to false and Ghast Fireballs no longer destroy blocks or start fires.
&lwither_griefing&r: set to false and Withers no longer destroy blocks from their spawn explosion, damage reactions, or Wither Skulls. Wither Roses still spawn.
&lenderman_griefing&r: set to false and Endermen no longer pick up or place blocks.

ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.6E1: Nature provides many gifts for you to use, one such being a delicious cup of tea. Each type of tea provides a beneficial effect well worth brewing.

To begin, simply use some shears on any vanilla Minecraft flower for a tea blossom. This special little sprout, once planted and grown, will get you started on your journey for the perfect cup of tea!
ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.72C: The most well-known and loved teas are the result of the ancient art of drying leaves from the tea blossom plant. You too can indulge in this art and create your own. Dry green tea leaves for a drink or further combine and dry them for black tea. You can also mix the 2 for oolong!

Craft together 9 green tea leaves harvested from the tea blossoms you’ve grown in a crafting table and place down the resulting block. Wait for it to become a dried green tea leaf block and break for dried green tea. Repeat with dried green tea to make black tea. Combine 4 dried green tea and 4 dried black tea to make an oolong.
ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.0D2: The noble tea blossom may provide the key to 3 different teas but that isn't the only way to make a great cup of tea. Many other plants can be used. Don't forget some sugar and milk!

Rooibos can be found in Savanna biomes. If you’re struggling to find them in a savanna try looking in a Steppe or similar hot biomes. Hibiscus and coffee grow in jungle biomes. Lavender and Yerba Mate can be found at higher elevation biomes near mountainous areas such as Cherry groves or Meadow biomes.
Collect 1 Rooibos leaf, 1 Hibiscus, 1 Lavender, 1 Yerba Mate, 1 Coffee bean, 1 sugar and 1 bucket of milk
ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.506: If you give to nature, nature will always give back. While things like coffee, rooibos and yerba mate can be planted and farmed, flowers like lavender and hibiscus cannot. Luckily they can easily be duplicated using bone meal to save you from having to find more.
&lTip: To get Lavender in a brewable state use shears to harvest lavender blossoms. Be sure you duplicated them first as lavender blossoms can’t be replanted!&r

ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.6EE: You’ve mastered the art of tea and found your favorite flavor, but are you ready for the secret power your tea holds? If you combine 3 of each of the different dried teas in a crafting table you can create an herbal infusion. This special infusion can be used in a brewing cauldron to take your potion-making to another level.

ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.76E: Have you ever wished you could drink several potions all at once? Now you can! ftbquests.chapter.tranquilitea.quest.2DF: With tools and materials in hand you’re ready to begin learning to brew. You should start with the easiest to brew tea, rooibos!

The kettle can be intimidating at first but it’s actually quite simple. Put a rooibos leaf into the top left square area and a glass bottle in the square beneath it. Then put a bucket of water in the square next to the measured bars on the right to fill it with water. When done right the progress arrow should begin to fill.

ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.title: Giddy Up
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.CCC228F: Open this book and read on.
Icy's Better Horses adds a full ownership and bonding system, 15 breeds with their own abilities, horse gear slots, and a cart for riding or storage. This chapter walks you through all of it.
The Stable Handbook is the mod's own in-game guide. Keep it on you as you learn the ropes.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.2D0D9EC: The Upgraded Saddle is the gateway item for the mod. Equip it on a tamed horse and five gear slots open up for horseshoes, barding, medkits, and more.
Hold the saddle in your hand near a horse to see its live stats.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.2C5CA5D: Fitted in a gear slot. Lets the horse walk on powder snow and halves fall damage.
A good first upgrade. Mountain and snowy terrain stop being a problem.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.4D07E61: Equipped in a gear slot. Auto-heals the horse the moment it drops below half health.
Expensive to make, but it keeps your horse alive on long rides and in combat.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.469C900: A fuel part. Required to craft the Glidewing Harness, and also used to refuel a spent Harness on an anvil.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.BD6AA0D: Equipped in a gear slot. Slows big falls, and if the fuel holds, cancels fall damage entirely.
Refuel it on an anvil with a Canister when it runs dry.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.0C7CDA3: Two of these build a Horse Cart.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.3B44F34: Hitches to any horse. Carries four riders OR a double-chest of storage.
Not every breed can pull one at full speed. Draft breeds (Belgian, Clydesdale, Percheron, Shire) handle it best. Haflinger learns to at bond 40.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.D519A46: Tame a horse the vanilla way and it registers to you immediately. You now own it.
Bond builds from 0 to 100 just by spending time near the horse, feeding it Golden Apples, or using Name Tags on it. Max bond grants up to +75%% speed and jump.
Each breed also unlocks a secondary ability at bond 40, and some unlock a third at bond 100.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.5F231EE: Look at an owned horse and press the Horse Command Wheel key (rebind in Controls if needed).
Follow trails you. Wander grazes in a 32x32 area. Stay holds position. Set Home marks the spot. Return Home sends it back there.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.DACF1BD: Horses are gender-gated now. You need one of each sex.
Foals inherit each parent's breed 50/50, so mixed breeds are possible. Stat rolls on the foal can beat both parents.
Keep breeding the best offspring to end up with a horse that outruns its ancestors.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.7EAB8EF: Run /horse trust <player> while looking at a horse you own.
That player can now mount it, ride pillion, drive the cart, open the gear screen, open storage, fit gear, and give commands. Full ownership stays with you.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.64B6484: There's a screen listing every horse you own, with its live coordinates.
From it you can whistle a horse to you, send it home, or disown it from anywhere in the world. Useful when you've forgotten where you parked it.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.98CB6FB: Read about the three fastest breeds.
Gallop burst: +35%% speed for 3 seconds. 5 second cooldown. No wind-up.
Found in Plains, Sunflower Plains, Meadow, Forest, Birch Forest.
Speed builds while moving, capping at +10%% after 20 seconds. Doubles to +20%% at bond 40.
Found in Desert, Badlands, Eroded Badlands, Savanna, Savanna Plateau, Windswept Savanna.
Standing-start burst. Stand still 1 second, then move: +30%% for 5 seconds. 10 second cooldown.
Found in Plains, Sunflower Plains, Savanna, Savanna Plateau, Windswept Savanna.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.B7692E0: Read about the three combat breeds.
Rider takes reduced damage while mounted. Reduction grows at bond 40.
Found in Meadow, Cherry Grove, Flower Forest, Plains, Forest.
Barding gives +25%% armor, and charge/kick damage reads armor too. At bond 40, barding grants the rider Resistance.
Found in Windswept Hills, Windswept Gravelly Hills, Windswept Forest, Old Growth Pine Taiga.
Mobs locked onto you but not yet swinging get intimidated and usually back off. Range widens at bond 40.
Found in Forest, Birch Forest, Old Growth Birch Forest, Windswept Forest, Dark Forest.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.1D5367E: Read about the three storage and labor breeds.
Six rows of storage, the biggest chest in the mod. At bond 40, seats three riders if there is no chest.
Found in Taiga, Old Growth Spruce Taiga, Old Growth Pine Taiga, Forest.
Four rows of storage. At bond 40, pulls a cart at full speed. At bond 100, Hearthlight: glows after dark and lights the ground it crosses.
Found in Snowy Slopes, Grove, Meadow, Frozen Peaks, Jagged Peaks, Stony Peaks.
Immune to slowing from soul sand, cobwebs, berries, and honey.
Found in Old Growth Spruce Taiga, Forest, Meadow, Plains.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.035E193: Read about the three exploration breeds.
Neutral mobs lose interest in you, and anything already angry drops the grudge. At bond 40 this extends to hostile mobs.
Found in Dark Forest, Forest, Pale Garden, Old Growth Spruce Taiga, Taiga.
Night vision while riding in the dark, no torch needed. At bond 40, Herding: with an empty hand, livestock within 20 blocks trail your horse.
Found in Plains, Flower Forest, Savanna, Sunflower Plains, Meadow.
Maps you fill while riding cover twice the usual ground. Three times at bond 40.
Found in Plains, Savanna, Meadow, Forest, Sunflower Plains.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.90A4AC9: Read about the three specialist breeds.
Immune to slowing from soul sand, cobwebs, berries, and honey. At bond 40, Winter Coat: neither horse nor rider freezes.
Found in Snowy Plains, Snowy Taiga, Ice Spikes, Frozen Peaks, Jagged Peaks, Snowy Slopes, Grove.
Nearby hostiles are outlined through walls and the horse snorts a warning. Also self-heals one heart every 15 seconds, no food needed.
Found in Plains, Savanna, Windswept Hills, Badlands, Wooded Badlands, Sparse Jungle.
Bonds 1.5x faster than any other horse. Doubles to 2x at bond 40.
Found in Plains, Meadow, Forest, Birch Forest, Flower Forest.
ftbquests.chapter.giddy_up.quest.CCC228F: Lose it? Combine a Book and a Chest in a crafting table to get another.
ftbquests.chapter.tips.quest.3351F596A4C: A vanilla Grindstone can do more than remove enchantments. Put your enchanted gear in the top slot and a Book in the bottom slot. The output is a Book carrying every enchantment from the gear, and the gear itself comes back clean.
Useful when you want to retire an old tool but keep its enchantments for the next one.
ftbquests.chapter.tips.quest.5227E98A9C2: Many of the player plushies you'll see in villages or get from the Wandering Plushie Trader are modeled after real content creators who supported Homestead by playing, streaming, or making videos about it.

Every plushie shows its description in the tooltip. Most list the creator's Twitch or YouTube handle. If a plushie belongs to someone you enjoy, consider following their channel. Homestead reaches more people because of them.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.66: Hex Focus in hand, you're finally ready to begin converting mundane items into magical ones and start performing rituals. To start you'll want to conduct the Celestial ritual, a special ritual performed at night that produces important crafting materials.

To get started you'll need to make a ritual table and braziers. The braziers are made by shift-right clicking on any wooden planks with an Athame. The ritual table is made by placing down some cobbled deepslate and right-clicking it with your hex focus to instantly convert it. Place up to 8 braziers freely around the table as long as they remain at the same y-level within an 8 block radius around the table.

&lThis ritual must be performed at night.&r With your ritual grounds prepared it's time to make a gale berry. First place down 3 celestial blooms around your ritual area. Place a glow berry on the table and glow stone dust and a feather on the braziers as an offering. Place salt on your offering braziers. Then you need only right click with your hex focus to initiate the ritual. Also note that this does draw the magic from the Blooms and use them up, leaving behind a dead bush.
ftbquests.chapter.herbal_hexesz.quest.23: Now that you've learned how to conduct the Celestial Ritual it's time to dive into Nature's Ritual. This ritual will allow you to create many different special items and equipment or even summon creatures unique to the mod. We'll use this ritual to craft a rabbage, a crop commonly used in various recipes that can also be thrown to deal damage.

The setup is similar to the Celestial ritual, but instead of Celestial blooms it requires at least 8 fully grown crops to be nearby. Place a beetroot seed on the ritual table and dreampaste, sweetberries, a poppy, and an iron nugget on the braziers with salt and initiate the ritual the same way as before.
There are also Summoning rituals which require a sacrifice to finish. Once the offering is made slay a living creature with an athame to complete the summoning.
ftbquests.chapter.tips.quest.B04A7D1F96E: Tokimi's Boatyard turns any vanilla chest boat into an upgradable one.

Place a chest boat in the crafting grid and surround it with 8 of a tier material to upgrade. Tiers go copper > iron > gold > emerald > diamond > netherite. Each tier adds more storage and more speed.
Add a saddle anywhere in the grid alongside the boat to add a seat. Max 8 seats total, capped at 6 saddles.
Need fewer seats? Place the upgraded boat alone in the crafting table and it gives back one saddle per seat.
